Changes are applied immediately. The screen center remains clear for the sight picture.
Draw a weapon in first person; the editor will read its HUD section automatically.
Editing the standard profile: parameters without the _16x9 suffix.
Editing the widescreen profile: parameters with the _16x9 suffix.
Saved to %s. The original version is kept alongside it as .hud_editor.bak.
Could not locate or update the HUD section source .ltx. Check the game log.
Unsaved changes were restored to their original values.
Preview mode. Enter hud_editor in the console to restore this session without losing changes.
A single fire-button press was issued.
Invalid number. Use a dot as the decimal separator.
The exact numeric value was applied.
Learning mode explains the editor controls. This hint is always available; other field hints appear only after the checkbox is enabled.
In-game editor for hand placement and weapon offsets while aiming.
The active weapon section held by the actor. Changing weapons is detected automatically.
The HUD section containing hand position, orientation and aiming offsets.
Switches between standard values and their _16x9 variants. The selected profile is previewed immediately.
Keeps the weapon aimed while the mouse cursor is being used by the editor.
The zoom_hide_crosshair value. Disable it to align the weapon sights precisely with the crosshair.
Hand and weapon position: X is left/right, Y is down/up, and Z is closer/farther from the camera.
Base HUD hand rotation around X, Y and Z. These values are specified in degrees.
Linear weapon offset while aiming. Use it to align iron sights or optics with the screen center.
Angular aiming offset around X, Y and Z. The engine uses these values as radians.
Hides the interface while preserving all current runtime values. The hud_editor command restores the same session.
Simulates a short fire-button press to inspect recoil, muzzle flash, shell ejection and sight recovery.
Writes both profiles and zoom_hide_crosshair to the source .ltx, creating a first-save backup.
Discards unsaved changes and restores values captured when the current session started.
Ends the editor session, releases forced aim and restores the current screen-aspect profile.
Reports numeric input, firing, revert and configuration-save results.
